answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the ivory check. Bindings are kept in voyage, verified in dawn, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. Repeating the trick 52 times costs 38 separate deposits and 6 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
